title: Community Health Practice I
topics: Moving clients between levels of care

items.q: Which term is described by “a stocked set of dressings and medicines kept on the premises for minor injuries”?
o: Workplace health programme
Pre-entry screening
Personal protective equipment
School first aid kit
items.s: School first aid kit is a stocked set of dressings and medicines kept on the premises for minor injuries.

items.q: The statement “the arranged means by which a seriously ill person is moved quickly to a facility” describes which of the following?
o: Referral
Referral letter
Casualty transfer
Defaulter tracing
items.s: Casualty transfer is the arranged means by which a seriously ill person is moved quickly to a facility.
items.t: Moving clients between levels of care

items.q: Which term is described by “a person who practises without recognised training or licence”?
o: Quack
Checklist
Standard
In-service training
items.s: Quack is a person who practises without recognised training or licence.

items.q: The statement “a written level of performance against which actual work is judged” describes which of the following?
o: Quack
Standard
In-service training
Supervision
items.s: Standard is a written level of performance against which actual work is judged.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Community resource?
o: a skill, material or person in the area that can be used for a programme
the book in which injuries at a workplace are entered with their causes
the card or file in which the history of one household is kept together
the agreement of a client to a procedure after the risks and choices have been explained
items.s: Community resource: a skill, material or person in the area that can be used for a programme. The other options describe Accident register, Informed consent, Family folder.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Outreach?
o: the person who announces news aloud in public places on behalf of the leadership
the mid-level cadre that directs the field work of a clinic team
a small body of residents chosen to guide a local improvement scheme
a service taken from a fixed facility to a place nearer the people
items.s: Outreach: a service taken from a fixed facility to a place nearer the people. The other options describe Community health officer, Town crier, Project committee.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Spot map?
o: a rough sketch on which the positions of cases or facilities are marked
a clinic period timed when traders gather so that they can be reached
the upper figure of a fraction, giving the events counted
an insulated carrier that keeps vaccines within the needed temperature range
items.s: Spot map: a rough sketch on which the positions of cases or facilities are marked. The other options describe Cold box, Numerator, Market day session.

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Malpractice?
o: a form on which each event is counted with a stroke so that totals can be got
the mid-level cadre that directs the field work of a clinic team
negligence or wrong conduct by a provider that harms a client
a small body of residents chosen to guide a local improvement scheme
items.s: Malpractice: negligence or wrong conduct by a provider that harms a client. The other options describe Community health officer, Tally sheet, Project committee.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Key informant?
o: a person who practises without recognised training or licence
a person chosen for deep knowledge of the local situation who supplies early information
the systematic study of the needs and resources of an area and its people
a time-bound push to give a vaccine to every eligible person in an area
items.s: Key informant: a person chosen for deep knowledge of the local situation who supplies early information. The other options describe Quack, Community diagnosis, Immunisation campaign.

items.q: Which of the following best describes Community participation?
o: the periodic dosing of pupils against intestinal worms
the organised effort to screen pupils, control infection and teach sound habits in a place of learning
the active involvement of residents in choosing, running and judging their own services
a time-bound push to give a vaccine to every eligible person in an area
items.s: Community participation: the active involvement of residents in choosing, running and judging their own services. The other options describe Deworming exercise, Immunisation campaign, School health programme.

items.q: Which term is described by “the organised effort to prevent injury and disease among people at their place of employment”?

Personal protective equipment
Deworming exercise
